items.statement: Retention money increased to 5% in NBCC projects, some retention not releasable against bank guarantee, creating working capital hold
items.quote: Yes, retention money. Ealier in CPWD, they were having a 2.5% retention money, but now most of the projects like we are doing is NBCC and alL. So, they have a 5% retention money

items.statement: Preferential warrant proceeds will fund acquisition of a non-India company or physical presence in North America, Europe or Australia
items.quote: And that's what we came out with our preferential warrant, where those money will be utilizing for acquiring a local non-India based company, mainly into North America or Europe or in Australia, but mainly in North America.

items.statement: Plans to invest Rs 12-18 crore over next 12-24 months on AI, blockchain and cybersecurity R&D and centre of excellence
items.quote: So, all in all, around 12 crores to 18 crores is what we are expecting to invest for R&D or for a center of excellence creation.
